import openpyxl

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('output.xlsx')
ws = wb['Foglio1']

# DATI data rows 2..78, K=ID, J=TOT
# For each Foglio1 row 2..18, ID in E, fill last-10 results into G..P
# header in row1 gives rank: G=10 oldest ... P=1 most recent
for r in range(2, 19):
    for c in range(7, 17):  # G..P (columns 7..16)
        h = ws.cell(1, c).value  # rank 10..1
        ws.cell(r, c).value = (
            f'INDEX(DATI!$J:$J,AGGREGATE(14,6,ROW(DATI!$K$2:$K$78)/'
            f'(DATI!$K$2:$K$78=$E{r}),{h}))'
        )

wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved')
